answer: What profit in a gale of masks when one player stands true? Each mask must crack a walnut of stake that only seasons can ripen: weight grows as the cube of seasons held — seven seasons, 343 voices in one. Split the same stake across ten fresh masks and each weighs one, a whisper against the storm, ten in all against 343. No gale of new arrivals can buy seasons. One honest player, one mask, and the seasons are his own.
